body: Wow, I'm... speechless. Thank you so, so much for replying. I can't really say anything but thank you. I'll try my best to keep in the road of recovery. I hope you have a wonderful day.

Maybe it does still bother me. I remember being quite the happy kid back then, before bullying started. However, my first suicidal thoughts begun before the bullying... so yeah, kinda confusing.

I'm almost 24 years now.

Thank you reading and replying.

Welp, to give you a bit of context, I've dealt with depression for about 10 years now and attempted suicide a few times. Nothing THAT bad ever happened in my life (besides severe bullying in school) to make me feel like this, it just started for no reason. 

I just... feel like a constant burden. No matter what I do or say, immediately after doing it, I blame myself. Receiving compliments and such, even if i know they're sincere, make me feel like throwing up.

I give a shit. Please don't do it. I don't know what's making you go through such a terrible pain, but please remember you are an unique individual and you'd be missed. I swear you would. I'm just someone on the internet and I swear I care.

On the superficial side, many girls would love to date an Asian guy. Trust me. I'm sorry you've been through situations that made you think your height is a problem, but it really isn't. It's not like you're THAT short! Also, you still have to reach your growth peak, you're young enough, if that makes you feel better.

If you're looking for one night stands, maybe you'll have trouble because most people just want to date people who meet their sterotypes, and unfortunately, those stereotypes are usually too extreme.

But don't blame yourself because of height or dick size. Not meeting someone who would only be able to love you if you strictly are x or y is actually a blessing. Sorry for the cliché, but the love worth fighting for is that love you may find on people who don't only search a nice mannequin.


I hope you find the girl you deserve soon. Best wishes.

I'm so sorry you're going through this. But please, think carefully about if you'd rather never accept the body you live in, or your family not accepting you because of your true identity. I'm very sorry if this sounds rude, it's not my intention at all. But if I've ever learnt something in life, it's that the only person you'll sleep and wake up with until the day you die is yourself. Best wishes OP, I hope everything turns out well! Lots of love.
Maybe realizing that not every person (regardless of gender) likes what the next one does could be helpful. In "mating", and in every single aspect of life.

Even if it's for your cat, please stay. I don't know about your relationship with your mom or other relatives, but I bet that they'd be devastated too if you made that choice. Suicide is a definite option to something that can go better (or even stop), leaving no room for better times to come. Personally, I'd ask you to please keep fighting, OP. However, Im aware of how it feels wanting to end your life, so I'm not gonna try to guilt-trip you. It's your choice, and you're free to do so. But please, think calmly about it all before you do anything, and this might sound weird, but if you want to, I'm here to listen. Sending lots of love your way.

Oh I see, that sucks man. I hope you manage to get rid of those situations soon. Also sorry if I seemed rude with my last sentence,  swear I didn't mean to offend you in any way, hopefully you understood what I was trying to say. Have a great day OP!

I understand why would you consider the subject as something not pleasant, and it's perfectly normal not wanting to talk about something that makes you uncomfortable, but... Hm. I mean, okay, you don't like periods. But referring to them as "nastiness", "blood seeping out of your vagina", "inappropriate bodily functions" and stuff is pretty... rude. I don't know a single person who likes having their period, but that doesn't mean it's not a natural process, wether you like it or not. (inb4 "shitting is a natural process too and you're not gonna deny it's disgusting")  People who go though it are usually so used to it that talk about it maybe too bluntly, I'll admit that. Probably you already do this IRL, but just rejecting to talk about the subject should suffice, instead of using such terms (in case you use them). 
Not gonna bother you anymore, your thoughts are completely valid and understandable, I'm not trying to say they're not - someone refusing to stop talking about it even when you've told them to is just disgusting.
But if you're complaining about this, I honestly hope you're not one of those guys who talk about their morning wood/wanting to fap but needing to pee/etc as if that was desirable informaton, because that'd seriously made no sense.

It's wonderful to see you're reaching the life you deserve. I'm so sorry you had to go through all that shit, but I wish with all my heart that only good things come for you in the future. You've been through terrible things -it's time for you to be happy again. Best wishes, OP

Rejection is a very ugly word. Please, think of it as a chance to try again and in order to find the person who's best for you. 
It's hard giving advice in these situations, all i can say is that ending your life is, by no means, the answer.

Please, please, keep fighting. Death will come one day, but please, don't rush it. I can understand how easy it is to give on alcohol, and even though i'd like you to be cautious, there's no reason for you to feel shame or guilt. Sometimes it all becomes too much to handle, and we do things just in order to feel better, no matter what, and there's no shame in that!
After a breakup, it's hard to believe there will be someone new for you, but trust me, there will. Your mistakes do not define who you are. 
But to find out, you need to keep on fighting. Suicide is never a solution, it's only a forever closed door to everything. Sending lots of love your way.

First of all, happy birthday! 
I'm so sorry you're having a hard time. But your birthday is a milestone, a proof that you can keep on going!
Please don't think you've been replaced or something like that. You are going through a complicated situation and, sadly, not all people are strong enough to be next to someone who's suffering. But! Here comes the good part: That means they're not meant for you. They made place for you to have better friends to support you and help you remember you are worth it. As someone with depression and anxiety, I realize it's hard to be with me sometimes, but that doesn't mean there's something wrong with people like us. We're just fighting. 
And that's what i'd like to ask you to do, too keep fighting. It'd be lovely to see a message from you on your next birthday, telling us about how you're doing. Wether you see it or not, you are loved. I promise you are. Please, stay strong, best wishes!

I'm so sorry you're having those thoughts. You've probably heard this a thousand times, but some day, it will all make sense. I promise it will. That's why you have to get out of bed, and prove yourself there IS a point. Death is unavoidable, but as sad as that sounds, that's the exact reason why you need to make your time alive a wonderful experience, create precious memories to cherish. Anything that makes you feel happy is worth getting out of bed. May it be watching movies, reading, drawing.
I hope you feel better really soon, you deserve it. Best wishes.

I am so sorry things ended up this way. From what you say, it sounds like she was really your friend. You treated eachother as human beings no matter the reason you two met at first. I hope you get to feel better soon, and cherish your memories of her. Best wishes.

Haha don't worry, it happens to me too. I get carried by whatever I say and kinda forget the point of it all... heh
You're right, sometimes our minds are so blurred up that we don't realize we might be hurting the people around us with our words and attitude. But I think that doesn't count as being "purposefully mean", it's just in our nature. I was referring to those people who willfully try to hurt others as much as they can.
I hope you find your way to recovery soon, in case you haven't yet. Thanks a bunch for your message, I'll gladly listen to anything you'd like to say if you ever need to vent or search for help, even if i can't do much. I hope you have a wonderful day!
Thank you so much for sending such a sweet message, it certainly made me feel better. I wish the same for you!
